$QQQ (November 7, 2026-Weekly Chart)

Since 2025, six yellow candles on the weekly chart have accurately signaled either a bearish trend or a period of sideways consolidation. The outcomes and recovery timelines have been consistent with the size of the move:

1. January 2025: Smaller pullback that recovered in about 1 week.

2. 2025 April crash: Major crash, followed by roughly 8 weeks of pullback before the next red (bullish) candle appeared.

3. 2025 November pullback: Smaller move that recovered in about 2 weeks.

4. 2026 March–April crash: Major crash, followed by roughly 8 weeks of pullback before the next red candle appeared.

5. 2026 July pullback: Smaller move that recovered in about 3 weeks.

6. Week of October 16, 2026 onward: Current yellow candle (ongoing).

Pattern notes
Bigger drawdowns (the two crashes) have required around 8 weeks (~2 months) to recover or show a clear bullish candle. Smaller pullbacks have resolved much faster, typically in 1–3 weeks.

RSI (9) observations

2025 April crash: RSI(9) reached an oversold reading of 19.
2026 March–April crash: RSI(9) reached 25.

Current week: RSI(9) is at 30.3 (not yet at the extreme oversold levels seen in the two major crashes).

Overall, the yellow candles have acted as reliable early warnings. The depth of the move and the RSI reading have historically helped distinguish between multi-week pullbacks and shorter consolidations. The current setup (yellow candle + RSI at 30.3) more closely resembles the milder pullbacks so far than the two major crashes unless it continues to dip deeper.
